title: Robert Spillane on Tom Brady's "dog in the fight" remark: "It made me feel sad for him"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Spillane on Tom Brady's "dog in the fight" remark: "It made me feel sad for him"
sources.description: When Patriots legend Tom Brady, whose statue sits outside the team's stadium, said before the Seahawks-Patriots Super Bowl "I don't have a dog in the fight," New England linebacker Robert Spillane said of the remark, "[P]ersonally it makes me sick."
